rule: No backtest is published until a price source is named and its storage terms are recorded
reason: R-20 requires the policy before the first backtest

rule: Every price row stores the source URL, the retrieval UTC timestamp and a SHA-256 of the raw capture
reason: provenance; matches the capture policy used for official pages

rule: Opening price is the first capture after publication; closing price is the last capture before kickoff
reason: CLV is graded against the close

rule: If no price can be captured, the market column stays blank and the row is flagged; it is never filled in
No residual, no CLV and no ROI figure is published until P1-P4 hold for that market
reason: prevents publishing a number that looks like an edge but is an artefact
